requirements.title: 默认精度下的大整数格式化不因浮点范围限制而溢出
requirements.quote: * Skip the float validation for values that are already Python integers. Integers are finite, and the existing integer formatting path preserves all digits.

requirements.title: 超出浮点范围的正负整数完整保留符号、千位分组和末尾数字
requirements.quote: * Add regression cases for positive and negative integers beyond the float range, checking the complete grouped output including the final 123.
